description: This file defines a template class 'FastUniformBits' for generating uniform random bits efficiently from a URBG (Uniform Random Bit Generator), including utility functions and internal mechanisms for bit masking and range calculations.

classes.name: FastUniformBits
classes.description: A template class providing fast uniform bit generation from a URBG, with methods for generating bits based on the range and properties of the underlying generator.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random value using the underlying URBG, dispatching to specialized generate functions based on the range properties.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Internal methods that generate random bits using either a simplified or rejection sampling approach depending on the range of the URBG.
